thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3723456789 created — smart-routing health anomalies detected for gateway-router. auto-pager -> #incidents. severity: P1.
Alisa: oncall — got paged. seeing 5xx spike across multiple customers, spikes started ~3723456750.
Devon: visualizing traces now. looks like a steady stream of health probes toggling back-and-forth between regions. requests are bouncing: us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east.
Priya: logs show healthcheck status flips for the same backend id within 2s windows. that smells like mirrored/secondary health probe config.
Sam: confirmed. top-level metric: routing_failures +400% and 99th latency doubled. customers A, B, C reporting degraded responses.
Alisa: first mitigation idea — pause cross-region auto-fallback policy to stop churn. can someone flip the policy to 'local-only' for 2m?
Leo: initiating temporary policy hold: `/rbac update routing-policy gateway-router --fallback-mode=local --reason="incident 3723456789"`
ops-bot: Running command: `rbac update routing-policy gateway-router --fallback-mode=local --reason="incident 3723456789"`
ops-bot: Command succeeded. routing-policy changed.
Devon: rerouting looks less noisy but still seeing flaps between us-east and us-west internal health state.
Priya: pulling probe config: found recent change 3723456600 by infra-team — they introduced healthcheck-mirroring for redundancy. the mirroring duplicates health probes across regions and marks remote signals as equal-weight.
Alisa: that mirrored probe patch likely causes race where remote probe failure toggles local health. roll it back. Sam, can you revert the mirroring toggles?
Sam: on it. reverting feature-flag `health.mirror.enabled` to `false` for gateway-router.
Sam: PATCH: `ffctl set health.mirror.enabled gateway-router false --source=emergency`
ops-bot: Applying feature flag change... success.
Devon: after FF rollback, traffic normalization started ~3723456793. error rate trending down. still some lingering 502s due to queued fallbacks.
Alisa: good. we should also increase healthcheck debounce to avoid tight flip windows. propose: health.probe.debounce_ms = 5000 (was 500).
Priya: updated debounce in staging earlier; applying now to prod: `cfg apply gateway-router --set=health.probe.debounce_ms=5000`
ops-bot: Applying config and restarting probe workers (graceful)
ops-bot: Restart succeeded.
Leo: routing churn now minimal. customers reporting partial recovery. need to check if any long-tail customer requests hit degraded backend.
Sam: running quick customer impact sweep: query `SELECT customer_id, error_pct FROM metrics.errors WHERE ts>3723456700 AND error_pct>0.05`
Sam: results: customer-42 (10%), customer-77 (6%), customer-ops-internal (7%).
Alisa: Priya — can you draft a short customer note for CS with root cause and mitigation steps? keep it factual: config change introduced mirrored healthchecks which caused cross-region signal echo, leading to fallback churn and elevated 5xx for small subset.
Priya: drafting now. will include timelines, what we changed (disabled mirroring, increased debounce, paused fallback), and remediation plan (postmortem + permanent safe defaults).
Devon: we should add a guard in the rollout pipeline to block `health.mirror.enabled` from being enabled without a Canary that checks for ping-echo. ticket: INF-8732.
Alisa: agreed. create the ticket and assign to infra. also add alert: "health-probe-echo-rate" to detect >1 flip/sec per backend over 10s.
Leo: created INF-8732 and alert rule.
Sam: monitoring shows errors back to baseline by 3723456808. marking incident impact window 3723456700-3723456808.
Alisa: thanks all. reallocate oncall to postmortem: Devon will own detection/graphing, Priya will own comms, Sam will own rollback details, Leo will own config guard.
oncall-rotation: next oncall — @Alisa clear to hand off to @Devon for postmortem follow-up.
Alisa: handing off to Devon. I'll remain on standby for escalations. :mag: :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3723456789 status -> mitigated (P1) — follow-up ticket INF-8732 created. logs archived.
Devon: starting notes in /confluence/incidents/3723456789 — will include timeline, diffs (`git log --stat infra/health-probes`), and replay steps.
Priya: sending CS blurb now. ETA 10m.
Sam: leaving command snippets used in thread in the incident doc for runbook updates.
Leo: recommend we default debounce to 2s in next release and disallow mirror without explicit canary.
Alisa: agreed. after-action: schedule a 30m blameless review within 48h.
incident-bot: Thread closed by Alisa at 3723456815.
